questions.question: How does the masked language model objective improve representation compared to standard left-to-right pre-training?
questions.evidence: the MLM objective enables the representation to fuse the left and the right context, which allows us to pretrain a deep bidirectional Transformer.

questions.question: How does the ELMo model construct the contextual representation for an individual token?
questions.evidence: The contextual representation of each token is the concatenation of the left-to-right and right-to-left representations.

questions.question: How is the input representation of a token formed from different embeddings?
